items.exampleEn: We walked along the narrow ridge between two valleys.
items.exampleZh: 我們沿著兩座山谷之間狹窄的山脊行走。

items.exampleEn: The children caught small fish in the creek behind the school.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們在學校後面的小溪裡抓小魚。

items.exampleEn: Worms help keep the soil healthy by making small holes in it.
items.exampleZh: 蚯蚓在土裡鑽出小洞，幫助土壤保持健康。

items.exampleEn: The rocky coast is beautiful, but it is not a good place for swimming.
items.exampleZh: 這片多岩石的海岸很美，但不適合游泳。

items.exampleEn: An owl can turn its head almost all the way around.
items.exampleZh: 貓頭鷹的頭幾乎可以轉一整圈。

items.exampleEn: Mist rose from the hot spring as the cold evening came.
items.exampleZh: 寒冷的傍晚降臨時，溫泉冒出陣陣霧氣。

items.exampleEn: Ozone is a gas with a sharp smell.
items.exampleZh: 臭氧是一種有刺鼻氣味的氣體。

items.exampleEn: This necklace is made of red coral and silver.
items.exampleZh: 這條項鍊是用紅珊瑚和銀做的。

items.sentenceEn: We could hear an owl in the trees, but we couldn't see it.
items.sentenceZh: 我們聽得到樹上的貓頭鷹，卻看不到牠。

items.audioEn: The creek is too deep to cross here, so let's walk to the wooden bridge.
items.audioZh: 這裡的溪水太深過不去，我們走到木橋那裡吧。
options: Wait for the water to fall

items.sentenceEn: Divers love this island because of its colorful coral and fish.
items.sentenceZh: 潛水客很愛這座島，因為這裡有色彩繽紛的珊瑚和魚。

items.sentenceEn: The early bird catches the worm, so I always start work at seven.
items.sentenceZh: 早起的鳥兒有蟲吃，所以我總是七點就開始工作。

items.stemEn: The mountain ____ looked like a sharp line against the evening sky.
items.stemZh: 山脊在傍晚的天空下看起來像一條銳利的線。

items.stemEn: Be careful on the ____ path; it's easy to fall on the loose stones.
items.stemZh: 多石的小路要小心，很容易在鬆動的石頭上跌倒。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my friends and I went camping in the hills. On the first morning, a thick mist lay over the valley, and we could only see the top of the ridge. We followed a small creek down to the coast, walking carefully on the rocky path. My friend, who studies science, explained how the ozone layer protects the earth and why warmer seas damage coral. That night, we heard an owl calling from the trees. In the morning, my little cousin found a worm and named it after his favorite cello player, which made everyone laugh.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我和朋友們去山上露營。第一天早上，濃霧籠罩山谷，我們只看得到山脊的頂端。我們沿著一條小溪走到海邊，小心翼翼地走在多石的小路上。我那位念科學的朋友解釋了臭氧層如何保護地球，以及海水變暖為什麼會傷害珊瑚。那天晚上，我們聽到樹上有貓頭鷹在叫。早上，我的小表弟找到一隻蚯蚓，還用他最喜歡的大提琴手的名字替牠取名，讓大家都笑了。

questions.questionZh: 第一天早上他們只看得到什麼？

options: 晚上怎麼在溪邊搭帳篷

items.promptZh: 早上的霧讓我們看不清楚前面的路。
referenceEn: The morning mist made it hard for us to see the road ahead.
Because of the mist this morning, we couldn't see the road clearly.
rubricZh: mist 指薄霧（例如 the morning mist）；fog 意思接近，但本題要用 mist

items.promptZh: 海水變暖讓很多珊瑚失去了顏色。
referenceEn: Warmer sea water has caused a lot of coral to lose its color.
Because the sea is getting warmer, much of the coral has lost its color.
rubricZh: coral 通常不可數（例如 a lot of coral、much of the coral 等）；寫 many corals 也正確
時態可用現在完成式或過去式（例如 has lost、lost 等）
「海水變暖」可寫，例如 warmer sea water、the sea is getting warmer 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：疑似干擾項也算對：釋義是「蟲；蚯蚓」，而中文口語常把「螞蟻」「蜘蛛」也叫蟲（蟲子），學習者可能猶豫；建議換成非蟲類（如青蛙、小鳥、蝸牛）或把釋義收窄為「蠕蟲；蚯蚓」。
